title: International Medical Fellowship in Paediatric Radiology
inst: Great Ormond Street Hospital for Children NHS Foundation Trust
Department: GOSH Learning Academy – International Medical Fellowship Programme
Deadline: Not stated on official page
Eligibility: Medical degree acceptable to the GMC; four or more years of specialty training at entry; passed Part 1 College exam or UK equivalent; postgraduate specialty qualification (UK Royal College membership/fellowship or equivalent home-country qualification); recent full-time clinical work; IELTS (7.0 each band, 7.5 overall) or OET (grade B each) within two years before GMC application; resident overseas when applying. Alternatively, already GMC-registered with at least four years of specialty training.
International applicants: Designed for international doctors; applicants must be resident overseas when applying and willing to return home after the visa expires.
Application method: Online application portal managed by the GOSH Learning Academy; eligible applications reviewed by the specialty, followed by a virtual interview and conditional offer.
Funding: Self/home-organisation funded: funding must be agreed with the home organisation to cover a placement fee; GOSH does not provide scholarships.
Visa support: Successful candidates complete visa applications as part of pre-employment checks; GOSH can provide GMC sponsorship for entry onto the UK Medical Register.
Licence requirement: GMC registration required (GOSH can sponsor GMC registration).
Summary: Radiology is one of the specialties offered through GOSH's International Medical Fellowship Programme, which provides tailored, typically 12-month training for international doctors well advanced in specialty training.
